text:
What is meant by the frequency of a water wave?
A
the distance between consecutive crests of the wave
B
the distance moved by the wave per unit time
C
the maximum vertical displacement of the wave
D
the number of crests passing a point per unit time

options.label: A
options.text: the distance between consecutive crests of the wave
